plugin.note: Demonbane melee or ranged with an explicit altar switch. Sacrifice a dark totem for each entry; Emberlight and Arclight alone have the altar one-hit effect.

requirements: A dark totem is consumed at the central Catacombs altar to enter.
Skotizo counts for black demon or greater demon assignments, but an assignment is not required to fight.
The Wiki suggests 75+ combat skills; weapon equip requirements and actual entry access are checked separately.
mechanics: Each active altar reduces damage by 15% for Arclight/Emberlight or 25% for other weapons, reaching 60% or 100% with all four.
Arclight and Emberlight disable an altar in one hit regardless of stats. Scorching bow, demonbane spells, Silverlight and Darklight do not share this effect.

methods.label: Demonbane melee
methods.summary: Emberlight or Arclight attacks both the boss and its altars without a separate altar weapon.
prayers: Protect from Magic while travelling; Protect from Melee or Magic according to the chosen position
steps: Use Emberlight or a charged Arclight on Skotizo.
Deactivate altars as they accumulate; use magic protection while travelling away from melee range.
With strong melee armour, use magic protection and step away between attacks; choose the high magic defence variant for the alternative prayer trade-off.
risks: Arclight needs charges; ownership does not establish sufficient internal charges.

methods.label: Scorching bow with demonbane altar switch
methods.summary: Keep distance with Scorching bow and carry Emberlight or Arclight for guaranteed altar hits.
prayers: Protect from Magic while ranging and travelling
steps: Keep out of melee range while attacking Skotizo and use magic protection.
Switch to Emberlight or Arclight for each altar; ranged demonbane damage does not grant the altar one-hit effect.
Restore run energy as needed and focus on the boss and altars rather than the re-summonable minions.
notes: The Wiki recommends scorching bow and twisted bow particularly strongly; other ranged choices can favour distance or account restrictions over damage.

methods.label: Ranged with blowpipe altar alternative
methods.summary: A charged toxic blowpipe is a source-listed altar alternative for players not using Arclight.
steps: Attack Skotizo at distance with the main bow.
Use the charged toxic blowpipe to damage active altars; this takes normal attacks rather than a guaranteed demonbane one-hit.
Prioritise altar control before damage reduction prevents boss damage.
risks: The blowpipe requires scales and loaded darts; altar kills are slower than the guaranteed Arclight/Emberlight effect.

methods.label: Dark totem entry and Catacombs routes
methods.summary: Prepare one complete dark totem for each arena entry.
steps: Assemble the three totem parts and sacrifice the dark totem at the central Catacombs altar.
Enter through King Rada I's statue in Kourend Castle courtyard; Xeric's heart is a nearby teleport route. The Wiki also lists Kourend Castle Teleport after Client of Kourend.
Carry an emergency teleport, prayer restoration and food before using the totem.

advisor.coverageStatus: Current raw Wiki supporting strategy reviewed; static reference

methods.label: Awakened altar control
methods.summary: Altars reduce outgoing damage and can be reactivated after a cooldown.
steps: Four altars may activate independently. Each applies 15% damage reduction against Emberlight/Arclight or 25% against other weapons.
Deactivate altars with the selected altar weapon; a deactivated altar has a one-minute reactivation cooldown.
Arclight and Emberlight always one-hit altars. Blood fury can heal from such a hit; the Wiki describes a 30-Hitpoint heal with Arclight when its effect activates.
Use stamina for repeated travel and magic protection while out of Skotizo melee reach.

methods.label: Minions and special weapons
methods.summary: Ignore replaceable minions and reserve special attacks for the boss.
steps: Below one third health Skotizo summons three reanimated demon spawns. A dark ankou may also appear while an altar is active.
Melee protection handles their attacks; killing these minions gives no strategic benefit and they can be summoned again.
Elder maul, dragon warhammer and Bandos godsword provide defence reduction, especially useful below best-in-slot gear. Burning claws or Voidwaker provide direct special-attack damage.

methods.label: Melee and ranged supplies
methods.summary: Use a short boss-trip inventory with the entry item and the correct altar solution.
steps: Melee: divine super combat or a super set, optional special weapon, two or three prayer potions, optional stamina, emergency teleport, dark totem and sharks or better.
Ranged: divine bastion, optional melee special and supporting equipment, mandatory altar solution, two or three prayer potions, stamina, teleport, dark totem and food.
Twisted bow and scorching bow are strong distance options; the Wiki equipment comparison also retains Bow of Faerdhinen and void alternatives with their complete set dependencies.
